requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.

requirements.text: All markings on the retro-reflector shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
atomic: All markings on the retro-reflector shall be clearly legible.
All markings on the retro-reflector shall be indelible.

requirements.text: The approval marking on the retro-reflector shall be sized according to the value for "a" defined in Table 1.
requirements.quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” is defined in Table 1.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the retro-reflector shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the retro-reflector shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.quote: The four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.

requirements.text: The sequential number in the approval marking of the retro-reflector shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the retro-reflector shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
requirements.quote: The symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the retro-reflector shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.

requirements.text: Where the approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark on the retro-reflector shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I.
requirements.quote: The approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. may be replaced by the Unique Identifier, if available. The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown below: Figure I Unique Identifier (UI)

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.

requirements.text: If such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer, the Class IA retro-reflector shall bear the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear 3.3.4.2.1. in case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
requirements.quote: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
atomic: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
The markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.

requirements.text: The retro-reflecting device shall meet the requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulation No. 48, and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval, pertinent to the retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
requirements.quote: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation. The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
requirements.quote: In addition, they must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
atomic: The retro-reflective devices must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation.
The retro-reflective devices must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their maintenance in good condition.

requirements.text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.quote: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall not be rough.
requirements.quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.

requirements.text: Any protuberances the outer surface of retro-reflective devices may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
requirements.quote: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, the retro-reflecting optical unit and filter must be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.

requirements.text: The retro-reflecting optical units and filters of the retro-reflector shall not be coloured by means of paint or varnish.
requirements.quote: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
atomic: The retro-reflecting optical unit of the retro-reflector shall not be coloured by means of paint or varnish.
The filter of the retro-reflector shall not be coloured by means of paint or varnish.

requirements.text: When tested for colour with the retro-reflective device illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0°, the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.quote: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° ... The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: If illumination at β1= β2= 0° produces a colourless surface reflection, when tested for colour with the retro-reflective device illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1., the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.quote: or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used. The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Class IA shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.quote: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: (a) The dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5;

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Class IA shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.quote: (b) The photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.;
atomic: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Class IA shall meet the photometric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Class IA shall meet the colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Class IA shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.quote: (c) The physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.

requirements.text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples of the rear retro-reflector shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.quote: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
atomic: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples of the rear retro-reflector shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6.

At least one hour after the heat resistance test, the ten samples of the rear retro-reflector shall be examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

At least one hour after the heat resistance test, the ten samples of the rear retro-reflector shall be examined as to their RI in paragraph 5.1.4. for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

requirements.text: The two rear retro-reflector samples giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.quote: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.

requirements.text: The two rear retro-reflector samples of the first group shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
requirements.quote: First group: The two samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
atomic: The two rear retro-reflector samples of the first group shall be subjected to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6).

If the water penetration test is satisfactory, the two rear retro-reflector samples of the first group shall be subjected to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).

requirements.text: The two rear retro-reflector samples of the second group shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
requirements.quote: Second group: The two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
atomic: The two rear retro-reflector samples of the second group shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6.
The two rear retro-reflector samples of the second group shall be subjected to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.

requirements.text: The two rear retro-reflector samples of the third group shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
requirements.quote: Third group: The two samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.

requirements.text: The two rear retro-reflector samples of the fourth group shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
requirements.quote: Fourth group: The two samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the rear retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.quote: A colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the rear retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., the verification being performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.quote: A RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4. The verification shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
atomic: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the rear retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.

The RI verification after the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1. shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

requirements.text: In the case where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements of the rear retro-reflector shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In the case where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA shall be considered.
requirements.quote: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector shall be limited to 100 cm2, though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.
requirements.quote: and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2 though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values of the Class IA red rear retro-reflector at an angle of divergence α of 20' shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3: 3.00∙10² mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 2.00∙10² mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; 1.00∙10² mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
requirements.quote: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors must be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
atomic: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the Class IA red rear retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20' and illumination angles β1 = 0°, β2 = 0° shall be equal to or greater than 3.00∙10² mcd∙lx-1.

When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the Class IA red rear retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20' and illumination angles β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0° shall be equal to or greater than 2.00∙10² mcd∙lx-1.

When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the Class IA red rear retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20' and illumination angles β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20° shall be equal to or greater than 1.00∙10² mcd∙lx-1.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values of the Class IA red rear retro-reflector at an angle of divergence α of 1°30' shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3: 5∙10⁰ mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 2.8∙10⁰ mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; 2.5∙10⁰ mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
requirements.quote: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors must be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
atomic: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the Class IA red rear retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 1°30' and illumination angles β1 = 0°, β2 = 0° shall be equal to or greater than 5∙10⁰ mcd∙lx-1.

When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the Class IA red rear retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 1°30' and illumination angles β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0° shall be equal to or greater than 2.8∙10⁰ mcd∙lx-1.

When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the Class IA red rear retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 1°30' and illumination angles β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20° shall be equal to or greater than 2.5∙10⁰ mcd∙lx-1.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall not have RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0° and β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°) within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) and (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.quote: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the following lines: (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
atomic: At an angle of divergence of 20', the RI values of the Class IA red rear retro-reflector within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°) shall not be lower than 1.00∙10² mcd∙lx-1.

At an angle of divergence of 1°30', the RI values of the Class IA red rear retro-reflector within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°) shall not be lower than 2.5∙10⁰ mcd∙lx-1.

requirements.text: Where the Class IA rear retro-reflector is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values of the rear retro-reflector shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB, is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.

requirements.text: The testing of the colour of the reflected light of the retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
requirements.quote: The testing of the colour for retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux must be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: The Class IA retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the tests in the chronological order specified in Table 4 (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB).
requirements.quote: Chronological order of tests Table 4 Chronological order of tests (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB)

requirements.text: When testing photometric performances of any mass-produced retro-reflective device chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.quote: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall not be contested if, when testing photometric performances of any retro-reflective device chosen at random no measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.

requirements.text: When the RI of the retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.
requirements.quote: When the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.

requirements.text: If any mirror effect is produced when the RI of the retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, a reading shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.quote: If there is any such effect, a reading shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is not marked "TOP", with an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', the retro-reflective device shall be rotated about its axis of reference to the position of minimum RI, which shall conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
atomic: Where the retro-reflective device is not marked "TOP", with an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0° (or the angle specified in paragraph 5.) and an angle of divergence of 20', the retro-reflective device shall be rotated about its axis of reference to the position of minimum RI.
Where the retro-reflective device is not marked "TOP", the minimum RI so found shall conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is not marked "TOP", when the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε, except that if the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference ±5° from that position.
requirements.quote: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε. If the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference ±5° from that position.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is marked "TOP", with an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', the retro-reflective device shall be rotated about its axis ±5°.
requirements.quote: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is marked "TOP", the RI shall not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during the ±5° rotation.
requirements.quote: The RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.

requirements.text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI of the retro-reflective device exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
requirements.quote: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of the Class IA retro-reflective device shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.quote: The shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.

requirements.text: When testing resistance to heat of the moulded plastics reflector of the Class IA retro-reflective device, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.
atomic: When testing resistance to heat, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C.
When testing resistance to heat, after the heat exposure the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.
requirements.quote: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
atomic: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking of the retro-reflective device or its optical component shall be visible.
After the resistance to heat test, no appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device or its optical component shall be visible.

requirements.text: For the test for resistance to water penetration, the retro-reflector shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
atomic: For the test for resistance to water penetration, the retro-reflector shall be stripped of all removable parts.
For the test for resistance to water penetration, the retro-reflector shall be immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C.
For the test for resistance to water penetration, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface of the retro-reflector shall be 20 mm below the surface of the water.

requirements.text: The water penetration test of the retro-reflector shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflector through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.quote: This test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: After the immersions at 50 °C ± 5 °C, the retro-reflector sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.quote: These sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.

requirements.text: After the test for resistance to water penetration, no water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
requirements.quote: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflector shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.quote: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflector being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.quote: In the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
atomic: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, the retro-reflector shall first be lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside before the RI is measured.

requirements.text: During the dust exposure test, all drain holes and other openings of the retro-reflector shall remain open.
requirements.quote: All drain holes and other openings shall remain open.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the retro-reflector shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
atomic: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the retro-reflector shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth.
Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be so designed that it retains the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
atomic: The retro-reflector shall retain the prescribed photometric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.
The retro-reflector shall retain the prescribed colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflector to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked, the testing of resistance to corrosion being as described in ISO Standard 9227:2017.
requirements.quote: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked. The description of the testing of resistance to corrosion is given in ISO Standard 9227:2017.
atomic: The resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflector to tarnishing shall be checked in accordance with ISO Standard 9227:2017.
The resistance of the protection of the rear face of the retro-reflector to deterioration shall be checked in accordance with ISO Standard 9227:2017.

requirements.text: For the corrosion test, the retro-reflector shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
atomic: For the corrosion test, the retro-reflector shall be stripped of all removable parts.
For the corrosion test, the retro-reflector shall be subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours.
For the corrosion test, the saline mist exposure of the retro-reflector shall comprise two periods of exposure of 24 hours each.
For the corrosion test, the two exposure periods shall be separated by an interval of two hours during which the retro-reflector sample is allowed to dry.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflector has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.quote: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
atomic: Where the retro-reflector has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C.

Where the retro-reflector has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline solution shall be obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water.
Where the retro-reflector has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the distilled water shall contain not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the retro-reflector sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.quote: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.

requirements.text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas of the retro-reflector, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
requirements.quote: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
atomic: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas of the retro-reflector shall be measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6.

After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas of the retro-reflector shall be measured at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20'.
After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas of the retro-reflector shall be not less than the value in Table 9.
After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas of the retro-reflector shall be not more than the value in Table 10.

requirements.text: Before measuring the coefficient of retro-reflection RA after the corrosion test, the surface of the retro-reflector shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
requirements.quote: Before measuring, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA, after having brushed the rear face of the retro-reflective device, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute, after which the cotton cloth is removed and the retro-reflective device left to dry.
requirements.quote: After having brushed in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA the rear face of the retro-reflective device, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture, defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute. The cotton cloth is then removed and the retro-reflective device left to dry.
atomic: Where the retro-reflective device is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA, the rear face of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed before the soaked cotton cloth is applied.

Where the retro-reflective device is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the rear face for one minute.
Where the retro-reflective device is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA, after the cotton cloth is removed the retro-reflective device shall be left to dry.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1 for a period of 500 hours.
requirements.quote: The samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6- 1: 3.1. in case of retro-reflective devices for a period of 500 hours,

requirements.text: When tested for resistance to fuels, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol.
requirements.quote: (a) The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.

requirements.text: When tested for resistance to fuels, after about five minutes the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually and shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.quote: (b) After about five minutes, the surface shall be inspected visually. It must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
atomic: When tested for resistance to fuels, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually after about five minutes.
When tested for resistance to fuels, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.

requirements.text: When tested for resistance to lubricating oils, the outer surface of the Class IA retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.

requirements.text: When tested for resistance to lubricating oils, after about 5 minutes the surface of the Class IA retro-reflective device shall be cleaned.
requirements.quote: After about 5 minutes, the surface shall be cleaned.

requirements.text: When tested for resistance to lubricating oils, the RI of the Class IA retro-reflective device shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The RI shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
atomic: The rear retro-reflectors shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

The rear retro-reflectors shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the rear retro-reflectors to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the rear retro-reflector when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed.
requirements.quote: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road; ... In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the rear retro-reflector when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed.
requirements.quote: in addition it shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices. In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting of the rear retro-reflector laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the rear retro-reflectors shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear retro-reflectors constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.quote: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.);

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear retro-reflectors constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, except that this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: Be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp;

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear retro-reflectors constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear retro-reflectors constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics.
requirements.quote: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics.

requirements.text: Where the rear retro-reflectors constituting a pair incorporate a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle and only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where the rear retro-reflector incorporates a logo, the rear retro-reflector shall not incorporate any logo that is not a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo.
requirements.quote: All logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other lamps only provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
atomic: Where the rear retro-reflector is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other lamps, the requirements regarding colour shall be fulfilled.
Where the rear retro-reflector is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other lamps, the requirements regarding position shall be fulfilled.
Where the rear retro-reflector is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other lamps, the requirements regarding orientation shall be fulfilled.
Where the rear retro-reflector is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other lamps, the requirements regarding geometric visibility shall be fulfilled.
Where the rear retro-reflector is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other lamps, the other applicable requirements, if any, shall be fulfilled.

requirements.text: Where the rear retro-reflector is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other functions, the photometric and colorimetric requirements of the rear retro-reflector shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which the rear retro-reflector is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
atomic: Where the rear retro-reflector is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other functions, the photometric requirements of the rear retro-reflector shall be fulfilled when all other such functions are switched OFF.

Where the rear retro-reflector is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other functions, the colorimetric requirements of the rear retro-reflector shall be fulfilled when all other such functions are switched OFF.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground of the rear retro-reflector shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, except that where the (maximum and minimum) height above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis. Where the (maximum and minimum) height above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
atomic: The maximum height above the ground of the rear retro-reflector shall be measured from the highest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
The minimum height above the ground of the rear retro-reflector shall be measured from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of the rear retro-reflector with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.quote: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.

requirements.text: The position of the rear retro-reflector, as regards width, shall be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle when referred to the overall width, and from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps, except that where the position, as regards width, clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.quote: The position, as regards width, will be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle when referred to the overall width, and from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps. Where the position, as regards width, clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
atomic: When referred to the overall width, the position of the rear retro-reflector as regards width shall be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.

When referred to the distance between lamps, the position of the rear retro-reflector as regards width shall be determined from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.

requirements.text: The red light reflected by the rear retro-reflector fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: To verify paragraph 5.10.1., there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of the red rear retro-reflector if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall not be concealed.
requirements.quote: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.

requirements.text: The colour of the light of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the rear retro-reflectors on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.quote: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
atomic: Where the rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component, the rear retro-reflector shall meet all the position requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
Where the rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component, the rear retro-reflector shall meet all the geometric visibility requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
Where the rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component, the rear retro-reflector shall meet all the colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
Where the rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component, the rear retro-reflector shall meet all the photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the rear retro-reflector observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles if they were already presented when the rear retro-reflector was type-approved.
requirements.quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. However, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.

requirements.text: If geometric visibility measurements of the rear retro-reflector are taken closer to the rear retro-reflector, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.quote: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.

requirements.text: If, when the rear retro-reflector is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the rear retro-reflector is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, the part of the rear retro-reflector not hidden by obstacles shall still conform to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.quote: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.

requirements.text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal of the rear retro-reflector may be reduced to 5º (rear retro-reflector at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5º (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be fitted on motor vehicles.
requirements.quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two.
requirements.quote: Number Two

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.quote: Two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
atomic: The rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be type-approved as Class IA or IB retro-reflectors according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3.

As an alternative, the rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be type-approved as Class IA or IB retro-reflectors according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.

requirements.text: The point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: In height: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm
atomic: The rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
The rear retro-reflector shall be not more than 900 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: Where the rear retro-reflector is grouped with any rear lamp(s), the rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s)
atomic: Where the rear retro-reflector is grouped with any rear lamp(s), the rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
Where the rear retro-reflector is grouped with any rear lamp(s), the rear retro-reflector shall be not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: Where the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively, the rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
atomic: Where the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively, the rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
Where the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively, the rear retro-reflector shall be not more than 1,500 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a geometric visibility horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 30° inwards and outwards.
atomic: The rear retro-reflector shall have a geometric visibility horizontal angle of 30° inwards.
The rear retro-reflector shall have a geometric visibility horizontal angle of 30° outwards.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal, except that where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below horizontal. However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
atomic: The rear retro-reflector shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 10° above horizontal.

The rear retro-reflector shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 10° below horizontal, except that where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Rearwards.

requirements.text: When the position of the rear retro-reflectors is checked for conformity of production, the values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to the rear retro-reflector are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: The values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.

requirements.text: When the angles of geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflectors are checked for conformity of production, the values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to the rear retro-reflector are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.quote: The values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the rear retro-reflectors shall be checked by visual inspection of the rear retro-reflectors and their markings.
requirements.quote: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
atomic: The presence of the rear retro-reflectors shall be checked by visual inspection of the rear retro-reflectors and their markings.
The number of the rear retro-reflectors shall be checked by visual inspection of the rear retro-reflectors and their markings.
The colour of the rear retro-reflectors shall be checked by visual inspection of the rear retro-reflectors and their markings.
The arrangement of the rear retro-reflectors shall be checked by visual inspection of the rear retro-reflectors and their markings.
Where applicable, the category of the rear retro-reflectors shall be checked by visual inspection of the rear retro-reflectors and their markings.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the rear retro-reflectors shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to the rear retro-reflector are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: These shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
atomic: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the rear retro-reflectors shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. are fulfilled.
